items.exampleEn: She studied math before she became an economist.
items.exampleZh: 她成為經濟學家之前是念數學的。

items.exampleEn: The government's new fiscal plan was announced on Monday.
items.exampleZh: 政府的新財政計畫在星期一公佈。

items.exampleEn: Many people in the town donated money to help rebuild the old temple.
items.exampleZh: 鎮上很多人捐錢幫忙重建那座老廟。

items.exampleEn: There were long lines for withdrawals before the holiday.
items.exampleZh: 放假前提款的人大排長龍。

items.exampleEn: Bankruptcy means that a company cannot pay what it owes.
items.exampleZh: 破產就是一家公司無法償還它欠的錢。

items.exampleEn: The museum depends on donations from visitors.
items.exampleZh: 這間博物館靠參觀者的捐款維持。

items.exampleEn: Her grandfather was a banker in London.
items.exampleZh: 她的爺爺曾是倫敦的銀行家。

items.exampleEn: An audit is a careful check of how a business spends its money.
items.exampleZh: 審計就是仔細檢查一家企業如何花錢。

items.exampleEn: The expensive new factory nearly bankrupted the company.
items.exampleZh: 那座昂貴的新工廠差點讓公司破產。

items.sentenceEn: The school asked parents to donate old books to the library.
items.sentenceZh: 學校請家長把舊書捐給圖書館。

items.audioEn: I made a withdrawal at the airport so I would have cash for the taxi.
items.audioZh: 我在機場提了款，這樣搭計程車就有現金可以付。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼在機場提款？
options: To pay for the taxi ride

items.sentenceEn: The economist expects prices to rise slowly next year.
items.sentenceZh: 那位經濟學家預期明年物價會緩慢上漲。

items.sentenceEn: The company's audit found a few small mistakes in last year's records.
items.sentenceZh: 公司的審計在去年的紀錄裡發現了幾個小錯誤。

items.stemEn: Without new customers, the small bookshop is close to ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有新客人的話，那家小書店就快破產了。

items.stemEn: The company's ____ year starts in April and ends in March.
items.stemZh: 這家公司的會計年度從四月開始，到三月結束。

items.passageEn: Last spring, a famous toy company went into bankruptcy. For years, its bankers had warned that the company was spending too much, and an audit later showed that it had lost money in every fiscal year since 2015. Economists said that online games had hurt its profits. Before closing, the company decided to donate its remaining toys to children's hospitals. The donation filled three trucks. Many people were surprised that the owner refused to make any withdrawal from the company's accounts for himself. "One bad decision can bankrupt a business," he said, "but it should not change who you are."
items.passageZh: 去年春天，一家知名玩具公司破產了。多年來，往來的銀行業者一直警告這家公司花錢太多，後來的審計也顯示，它從 2015 年起的每個會計年度都在虧錢。經濟學家說，線上遊戲傷害了它的獲利。關門之前，公司決定把剩下的玩具捐給兒童醫院，捐出的玩具裝滿了三輛卡車。很多人驚訝的是，老闆拒絕從公司帳戶為自己提領任何一筆錢。他說：「一個錯誤的決定就能讓一家企業破產，但它不該改變你是什麼樣的人。」

options: 老闆偷偷把公司的錢轉到國外帳戶
公司從2015年起每年都虧錢

questions.questionZh: 公司關門前把剩下的玩具怎麼處理？

items.promptZh: 我們收到一位老顧客的大筆捐款。
referenceEn: We received a large donation from a loyal customer.
A loyal customer gave us a big donation.
rubricZh: 「大筆」可寫，例如 a large donation、a big donation 等
「老顧客」可寫，例如 a loyal customer、an old customer 等

items.promptZh: 她把這場演唱會的收入全部捐給了一所小學。
referenceEn: She donated all the money from the concert to a primary school.
She donated all her earnings from the concert to an elementary school.
rubricZh: donate 的用法，例如 donated … to a school 等
「收入」可寫，例如 the money from the concert、her earnings 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 donated、has donated 等）
